question: How many customers ordered in each store country?
referenceSql: SELECT s.Country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM dbo.Orders AS o JOIN dbo.Stores AS s ON s.StoreId = o.StoreId GROUP BY s.Country ORDER BY s.Country
